paheṇaka.cp: neut. a present fit to be sent to someone.

C: paheṇaka：[nt．] a present fit to be sent to someone．
P: Paheṇaka，（nt．） [cp．BSk．praheṇaka in sense of “sweetmeat” at Divy 13，258； the *Sk．form is prahelaka] a present J．VI，369 （so here，whereas the same word as pahiṇaka at A．III，76 clearly means “sweetmeat”）．（Page 449）
R:
paheṇaka：ပ-ဟေဏက （န）
လက်ဆောင်။
DOP: paheṇaka pahenaka pahiṇaka n.
